Privacy Policy

Money Flow Privacy Policy

Effective: August 25, 2026Last updated: August 25, 2026Version: 1.0

Money Flow stores your financial data locally on your device. It does not have an account or login system, and it does not send your data to any server, because no such server exists for this app.

Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains what information Money Flow stores and how it is handled. Money Flow does not have an account or login system: there is no sign-up, no username or password, and no user profile stored anywhere but your own device.

Information Stored Locally

Money Flow stores your financial data, including accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, goals, investments, and loans, in a local SQLite database on your device. App settings and preferences are stored in a local key-value store on your device.

None of this data is transmitted to any server, because no such server exists for this app. It remains on your device unless you choose to export or back it up yourself.

Information You Can Export

You can choose to export your data as a CSV file or create a local backup file. These are user-initiated actions performed through your device's operating system document picker or share sheet.

Once you export or share a file this way, it is outside of Money Flow's control. The app cannot track, modify, or delete copies of files you have saved or shared elsewhere.

Cloud Backup (Google Drive)

The app includes code for an optional Google Drive backup feature, using Google OAuth and the Drive app-data scope. This feature is currently disabled and is not available to users; it appears in the app as "coming soon."

If this feature is enabled in a future update, this Privacy Policy will be updated first to describe what data it stores and how.

Permissions

Money Flow requests only the permissions it needs for the features you choose to use:

  • Biometric (fingerprint/face) — Optional app-lock unlock; handled by the device OS
  • Notifications — Only used if you enable reminders
  • File access (via OS document picker/share sheet) — Only used when you import, export, or back up data

Advertising

The app integrates the Google Mobile Ads SDK, but it is currently configured with Google's public test ad unit IDs only. Money Flow is not serving live ads at this time.

This section will be updated if and when live ads are enabled.

Crash and Error Reporting

Money Flow includes Firebase Crashlytics, a crash-reporting SDK, and the app's build configuration marks it as enabled by default for a production release.

As distributed today, Crashlytics does not send any data: it is automatically turned off during development, and the Firebase project configuration file it needs to connect to Firebase has not yet been added to this app, so it cannot report anything even in a release build.

If that configuration is completed in a future release, Crashlytics would begin collecting crash and error diagnostic data (such as device information and stack traces) to help us fix bugs, and this Privacy Policy will be updated before that takes effect.

Device Integrity Checks

Money Flow performs local checks for rooted or jailbroken devices, mock locations, and tampering or hooking frameworks, and it also uses the Google Play Integrity API. These checks read device signals locally to help protect your data.

These checks are not used to identify or track you.

Data Security

If you set a PIN, it is salted and hashed using SHA-256, and stored in secure, encrypted local storage on your device. Biometric unlock is handled entirely by your device's operating system; the app never receives your biometric data.

Backup files are automatically encrypted before being saved locally or uploaded, using an app-level key built into the app. This key is not a unique secret generated per user; it is derived using chained SHA-256 hashing (2,000 rounds) rather than a password-based key derivation function such as PBKDF2. This provides a basic layer of protection for backup files, not a strong, per-user encryption guarantee, and no security measure is perfect.

Children's Privacy

Money Flow is a general-purpose personal finance tool and is not directed at children. It does not knowingly collect information suggesting use by children.

Data Retention and Deletion

Your data persists on your device until you reset the app's data or uninstall the app. Because there is no server-side account or database for Money Flow, there is no server-side copy of your data to retain or delete.

Changes to This Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time, for example if a currently disabled feature such as cloud backup or live advertising is enabled. The effective date at the top of this page will be updated whenever changes are made.

Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, you can reach us via the contact details on our Support page.
